messages:
Olivia (Partnerships): quick sync for marketplace go-live checklist. target public launch Mon 2026-12-07 09:00 PST (embargo). key extras this time: EU localization for press, accessibility alt-text deadline, partner tech webinar slot. who owns which?
Marcus (Marketing): Ill own PR microcopy + translated press snippets (EN/FR/DE). will need partner approval for translated quotes.
Jules (HW Partner): we can provide partner quotes in EN and FR. uploading hero art now. note: we require our legal review before translations go live.
Priya (Legal): reminder: for EU translations, we need DPA confirmation for any partner-stored customer data linked from listing. add DPA status to PR doc.
Eve (Product): landing requirements: partner hero, SI quickstart link, demo sandbox creds, tracking events: marketplace_imp, partner_cta. also add an accessibility block (alt text + keyboard focus) — DevEx to QA.
Kai (DevEx): will wire events and a11y checks. opening ENG-14200 for event wiring and ENG-14201 for alt-text QA. ETA Fri 12:00 PT for wiring.
Marcus (Marketing): PR doc link: https://docs.redwood.example/drafts/marketplace-localized-pr-v1 ; added translation placeholders and a fallback English-only blurb. please add partner approval pages.
Jules (HW Partner): uploaded assets: https://files.partner.example/jules/hw-heroes/v3 (manifest.json included). assets include dark/light, svg logos. tagged jules-v3.
Olivia (Partnerships): timeline: Thur EOD partners approve translated quotes -> Fri 18:00 PT legal DPA + logo attestations -> Sat prod dry-run -> Mon prod push (embargo lift 09:00 PST).
Priya (Legal): added DPA checklist to PR doc. also require partner logo license and exact display name per MSA. no numeric perf claims in any language.
Marcus (Marketing): noted - removing the throughput number from all translations.
Eve (Product): fallback plan if translations delayed: show English + language selector disabled with tooltip "Localized content coming soon"; partner webinar scheduled as backup comms.
Olivia (Partnerships): partner webinar: Fri 2026-12-04 10:00 PST — 30min technical onboarding + QA. Jules, can you join?
Jules (HW Partner): yes. we'll present a 10min demo and hand over sandbox creds. pls circulate slides 24h before.
Kai (DevEx): for SI quickstart, shall we host a 1-page gist + PDF? I'll add si_quickstart_download event. snippet:
```
# SI quickstart (example)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/connect 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
 -d '{"partner_id":"JULES-01","mode":"sandbox"}'
```
I'll host under /docs/si/jules-quickstart.pdf
Marcus (Marketing): social + partner channels will get a translated 2-line blurb and hero image variants. need alt text from DevEx for accessibility.
Kai (DevEx): adding alt-text checklist: all hero images MUST include descriptive alt (<=120 chars) and decorative images marked empty alt. I'll post examples in the PR doc.
Priya (Legal): two legal asks: 1) confirm partner consent for press distro list (include email list), 2) footer logo links must go to partner legal page per MSA. Marcus pls add link targets.
Marcus (Marketing): added footer link targets and partner contact info for distro consent.
deploy-bot: staging preview scheduled 2026-12-03T02:00Z -> https://staging.redwood.example/marketplace/preview-20261203 (build: marketplace-localized-v1)
press-bot: note scheduled embargo notification to press list set for Mon 2026-12-07 08:55 PST if legal stamp received by Sun 20:00 PT.
Eve (Product): smoke test plan: 1) hero rendering across breakpoints, 2) partner_cta emits partner_id, 3) si_quickstart_download tracked, 4) translations render encoded characters correctly.
Olivia (Partnerships): please add one more: CDN optimize hero for EU region (image resizing + webp). Kai can you coordinate with infra?
Kai (DevEx): noted. creating INFRA-5599 to ensure CDN config with image transformation for EU edge. ETA Sat morning.
Jules (HW Partner): quick ask: can we have a partner-specific analytics tag for our internal team (utm_partner=jules)? Eve/Kai pls confirm.
Eve (Product): yes — we'll append utm_partner param on partner_cta_click redirect. ensure privacy-safe (no PII).
Priya (Legal): confirm utm param only, no PII or hashed tokens. Jules pls confirm their analytics only consumes UTM.
Jules (HW Partner): confirmed, only UTM.
Marcus (Marketing): final checklist in PR doc updated. I'll flag "PR ready" Fri 18:10 PT.
Priya (Legal): I'll aim to do DPA + logo review by Fri 19:00 PT once assets are in doc.
Olivia (Partnerships): day-of rollcall: Marcus (marketing), Kai (DevEx), Eve (prod), Priya (legal), Jules (partner). we'll use this thread for final signoffs.
deploy-bot: prod dry-run scheduled Sun 2026-12-06 23:00 UTC. smoke test ticket: https://jira.redwood.example/browse/ENG-14202
Marcus (Marketing): thanks team — will ping when translations approved by partners. :rocket:
Olivia (Partnerships): thanks all. using thread for webinar link + day-of playbook.
press-bot: reminder: include translated embargo header in emails and add locale-specific send windows for FR/DE recipients.
